**Test Case ID:** TC-NTPDP-06
**Title:** Hero heading and primary CTAs for Tata Yodha 2.0
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Confirm the product H1 and primary CTAs (Get On Road Price, Check Offers) on Tata Yodha 2.0.

**Expected Result:**
H1 matches the product name; Get On Road Price and Check Offers are visible.

**Steps:**
1. Open PDP and close launch lead
